description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'ProjectReportSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM' project. It extends 'DateRangeSearchFilterParams' and includes properties and methods for filtering project reports based on project ID and timesheet approval status. It also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: ProjectReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters related to project reports, including project ID, timesheet inclusion, and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sort field 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID filter value.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter value.

methods.name: getIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the timesheet inclusion filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter value.
